primaryTextChecks.text: The LORD’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.

contextChecks.before: The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
contextChecks.after: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
